_meta.prevalence_basis: share = count / n_train_rows, count = rows where cc_<token>==1 in X_train
notes: The 17 conditioned tokens must be DERIVED in code (see §7), never emitted by the LLM (§8 guardrail #3).
The LLM emits a base concept (see emittable_bases) + evidence span; code resolves the conditioned form.
emittable_bases whose base_in_vocab=false have NO plain cc_ column: code MUST pick a conditioned form (with the documented default), it cannot fall back to a base column.
feature_cols total is 552 (200 cc_ + 281 CCS + 48 med + 13 categorical + 3 utilisation + 7 vital), not 553 as the spec prose rounds it; Phase 3 must assert length == len(feature_cols) == 552.

decreasedbloodsugar-symptomatic.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'decreasedbloodsugar' (hypoglycemia); code sets -symptomatic (the only low-blood-sugar form present). No plain base column exists.

elevatedbloodsugar-nosymptoms.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'elevatedbloodsugar'; code sets -nosymptoms when high glucose is reported without symptoms. No plain base column exists.

elevatedbloodsugar-symptomatic.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'elevatedbloodsugar' (a.k.a. hyperglycemia) + symptom evidence; code sets -symptomatic when symptoms accompany the high glucose. No plain base column exists.

fall>65.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'fall'; code sets fall>65 when age>65, else keeps cc_fall.

fever-75yearsorolder.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'fever'; code sets fever-75yearsorolder when age>=75.

fever-9weeksto74years.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'fever'; code sets fever-9weeksto74years when 9 weeks<=age<75 (all adults 18-74).

follow-upcellulitis.derivation_rule: Follow-up visit for known cellulitis; code sets it when the note frames a cellulitis re-check, else keeps base cc_cellulitis.

headache-newonsetornewsymptoms.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'headache' + onset/history span; code sets -newonsetornewsymptoms for new onset or new/changed symptoms.

headache-recurrentorknowndxmigraines.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'headache' + history span; code sets -recurrentorknowndxmigraines when recurrent or a known migraine dx is stated.

headachere-evaluation.derivation_rule: Re-evaluation visit for a prior headache. Visit-context token (cf. woundre-evaluation), not age/history-conditioned; code sets it when the note frames this as a headache re-check/re-evaluation.

overdose-accidental.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'overdose' + intent span; code sets -accidental when intent is accidental OR unstated (default). No plain cc_overdose column exists, so one of the two forms MUST be chosen.

overdose-intentional.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'overdose' + intent span; code sets -intentional when intent is deliberate/self-harm.

post-opproblem.derivation_rule: Visit-context compound (recent surgery / post-operative complication), NOT age/intent/history-conditioned. Self-based: emitted only when the note frames the visit as a post-op problem; code owns it so the LLM does not guess post-op status.

seizure-newonset.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'seizure' + history span; code sets -newonset when NO prior seizure history is stated.

seizure-priorhxof.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'seizure' + history span; code sets -priorhxof when a prior seizure history is stated. No singular cc_seizure column exists (only plural cc_seizures, n=127); code must choose a form or the rare plural fallback.

withdrawal-alcohol.derivation_rule: LLM emits base 'withdrawal' + substance span; code sets -alcohol when substance is alcohol (the only withdrawal form present). No plain base column exists.

woundre-evaluation.derivation_rule: Re-evaluation of a prior wound; code sets it for a wound re-check visit. Base concept 'wound' has no plain column (nearest: cc_woundcheck).

respiratory.description: Breathing / dyspnoea complaints. Prefer the common token; the rest are rare alternates.

headache.description: Headache complaints. Common forms are age/history-conditioned; LLM emits base 'headache'.

seizure.description: Seizure complaints. LLM emits base 'seizure'; code derives new-onset vs prior-hx.

fever.description: Fever complaints. Common forms are age-conditioned; LLM emits base 'fever'.

alcohol_substance.description: Alcohol / drug / overdose / withdrawal cluster (behavioural + substance).

blood_sugar.description: High/low blood-sugar complaints. Forms are symptom-conditioned; no plain base column.

wound_skin.description: Wound / cellulitis / skin complaints incl. follow-up & re-evaluation visit forms.

fall_trauma.description: Falls and trauma. fall>65 is age-conditioned on base 'fall'.
